description: READ THIS BEFORE WRITING TO THE CRM (a person, a next step, a note) and, for the reader, BEFORE DECIDING A PERSON'S NEXT STEP. Compiled from CRM-CONTRACT.md; never edit by hand.
usage: The reader proposes one next step per person from the person's state plus the new event; this skill is in its prompt on every call.
In front: what the hit counts say is still needed. Assumed: still checked, back in front the moment it fires.
procedure: Check the step did not already happen ({R:already-happened}).
Owed replies first ({R:owed-first}); one step per person ({R:one-step}) with its origin ({R:origin}).

rules.rule: A to-do that names a contact is that person's next step in the CRM, never a separate task.
One person, one next step: a new proposal replaces the old one.
rules.example: "follow up Tuesday" replaces "follow up Friday", never both

rules.rule: Every step carries its origin: the event or the sentence it came from.
rules.example: step "send the deck" with origin "meeting note 2026-01-07, their ask at the end"

rules.rule: A reply the owner owes comes before anything else on Today.
Before proposing a step, check it did not already happen (sent message or calendar event after the step date closes it); default cadence two working days after an unanswered message.
rules.example: a follow-up proposed for someone met yesterday: closed with the calendar event as evidence

rules.rule: Never guess a contact route; an unknown route is a search, shown for review.
rules.example: no first.last@company guess: "route unknown, search proposed"
